description: Import a live Supabase project into an environment. POST /v1/imports. With dry_run true it reports what would move and changes nothing; without it the import starts in the background (so requires confirm) and returns an import_id to follow with import.status.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply this mutation; otherwise the tool returns the request it would send for approval.

dry_run.description: Report only, do not migrate (default false)

name: import.supabase
